case.geometry: unit sphere a = 1 m, disturbance potential u = z/(2 r^3), unit stream +z
case.reference: closed form grad u = e_z/(2 r^3) - 3 z x/(2 r^5) at the probe
case.traces: exact analytic values at panel centroids (no solve)

verdict.statement: At fixed physical clearance the constant-panel near-wall velocity converges (order 3.19 at d = 0.05 m, equator); at fixed d/h_max it is scale invariant (spread x1.23). The m3xxx claim that refinement is not a lever holds only for the fixed-ratio experiment.
